prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Katy, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1163; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you reported in Katy, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give you the details of what happened, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine, but I do need the name on the record first, and then we can go through the events.

A: Understood. It's the policyholder's driver speaking.

Q: Thank you. Can you walk me through what happened when you pulled into the lot?

A: I was backing out of a space near the store entrance. It was busy, with carts everywhere. I checked my mirror, saw nothing, and started to reverse slowly.

Q: What was your speed when the impact occurred?

A: Very slow, maybe walking pace. I felt a bump and stopped right away.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before contact?

A: No. It came from my blind side, behind the SUV parked next to me.

Q: How are you feeling now?

A: Not great. I hit my head on the steering wheel when I braked. I had a headache that got worse, and I felt dizzy and foggy for a while. My doctor has told me I have a concussion and I need to limit screen time and rest.

Q: Did you seek medical attention the same day?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that afternoon, and I was referred for follow-up.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I'm cooperating fully and I'll send any medical paperwork you need.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
